## Why

The site over `sig-2026-09-27-ce480ab1` carries false or unsupported
claims that stay public until republish #1: a fabricated two-reviewer
"Releasable" hostile-reader review (ADR-179), a "one-click / anonymous"
dispute promise (ADR-180 — the receiver is not operating), "editorial
board"/"counsel" process claims (no counsel exists — ADR-167/H-6),
"human-verified" P/R/F1 1.000 holdout claims (F-192), "permalink" /
"reproducible" wording (QW-5/TS-10 — no `/s/` pins exist), a public
`/visual-language/` reference, `demo_*` task routes, and copy that
promises a live intake.

## What this does

- **R1.1 — the fabricated review is gone, the real gate stands.**
  `HOSTILE_READER_REVIEW` removed from the fixture;
  `getHostileReaderReview()` returns the export artifact when present,
  else `null`; `assertReviewReleasable(null)` passes while a *recorded*
  review still requires ≥2 reviewers and no open findings (ADR-179).
  `/editorial-standards/` renders N-1 "Not yet performed." plus pending
  copy recording that the previously published review record was
  incorrect and removed, and the temporary release-block waiver.
- **R1.2 — truthful dispute intake.** `/dispute/` rewritten: e-mail
  only; the operator's address is injected at build time via
  `SIG_DISPUTE_EMAIL` (**never committed** — `web/src/lib/intake.ts`),
  and the page carries `data-intake-email="set"|"unset"`; senders
  disclose their sending address; no response time is promised; the
  handling order is privacy-harm/safety → factual corrections →
  everything else (WV-08); the online receiver stays "Not operating
  yet." (N-2); no requirement ids in rendered copy (C4 NEW-20).
  `DisputeLink`, `corrections`, `HowWeKnowThis` aligned ("one click,
  no account required", "anonymous" gone).
- **R1.3 — `/visual-language/` withdrawn.** Denied in
  `ops/public_routes.toml`; `http-absent` probes on apex/web/bucket
  origins in `ops/cadence.toml`; absent from both build modes;
  `robots.txt` stops advertising it; e2e registries updated.
- **R1.4 — no fabricated verification.** The "frozen, human-verified
  holdout" P/R/F1 1.000 block is replaced by the honest disclosure:
  "Development evidence only — the label sets were produced by an AI
  model and by agents; no person labelled them." — provisional basis
  and the D-R6.1-EVAL deferral preserved.
- **R1.5 / H-6 / legal home.** "Editorial board" and process-"counsel"
  removed; the pinned publication-basis disclosure ("Published on the
  maintainer's own rights and publication decisions. No lawyer's
  written opinion has been obtained; nothing here states that this
  publication has been cleared by counsel.") renders site-wide in the
  BaseLayout footer and on `/methodology/`; the ADR-165/E2-04
  legal-home sentence lands verbatim on `/terms/`. A test asserts
  "counsel" occurs nowhere outside the pinned disclosure.
- **R1.6/R1.7 — no permanence claims.** No rendered public prose claims
  "permalink" or "reproducible" (visible-text scan; `data-testid`
  identifiers are markup, not prose). Citations describe the as-of
  pair + ruleset.
- **R1.8 — interim `/sources/`.** Rows are derived at build time from
  the export's own compartment `sites.jsonl` `_rights` blocks — the
  licence/credit shown is what the download bytes carry. P34.19's
  express-terms disclosure renders from `web/terms_disclosure.json`
  with committed fallback to
  `policy/src/policy/data/express_terms.json`; missing/wrong credit
  renders N-4 until P34.21b's attribution re-export. Source-id
  decision (recorded in the run ledger): table rows carry the source's
  true registered id — data, not a handle-keyed page (R1.11's scope is
  routes; no handle-keyed page is emitted).
- **R1.9 — demo strip.** No `demo_*`/`task/` route in either build
  mode; `/task/new/` stays denied; the publish validator refuses demo
  path segments, `demo_` hrefs and demo task-field markers.
- **R1.10 — `/status/`.** Names what is known-wrong right now: N-7
  verbatim + the A-20 release/API freshness notice + publication
  basis; status sentences cite the probe-run record in the run ledger.
- **Publish gates (B-2 enforced in code).** `ops/publish.py` refuses:
  top-level entries not on `ops/public_routes.toml`; missing required
  entries; curation banners, loopback form actions and `demo_` markers
  in the tree; every rendered `data-copy` id that isn't a `confirmed`
  copy-batch row (pending rows reported in dry-run, refused under
  `--apply`); and `/dispute/` carrying `data-intake-email="unset"`.
- **Copy batch #1.** Every authored/changed sentence is a sha256-pinned
  row in `docs/build/reports/copy-batches/batch-01.md`, all `pending`
  until the operator's verbatim batch confirmation; DC-19 superseded
  (dispute copy moved to the injected address). `data-notice` strings
  N-1…N-7 ride the temporary notice allowance.
- **Build fix found in verify.** `web/src/lib/data.ts` `repoRoot()`
  resolved `../../../` from `import.meta.url` — correct in source,
  wrong in the bundled prerender chunk (`web/dist/.prerender/chunks/`),
  which made `SIG_DATA_SOURCE=export` builds fail to find the export.
  `repoRoot()` now walks to the `uv.lock` workspace marker, and a
  repo-relative `SIG_EXPORT_DIR` is anchored at the repo root in both
  `data.ts` and the `astro.config.mjs` tile-copy hook.

## Tests

Every behaviour has a test that fails if removed:

- `tests/unit/test_p34_17_web_honesty.py` (8) — visible-prose scan for
  the forbidden claims across every public `.astro`; requirement ids
  barred from the wave's rewritten copy (C4 NEW-20, scoped so
  pre-existing pinned citations on untouched pages aren't wave business);
  "counsel" allowed only as the pinned disclosure; dispute-page truth
  assertions; verbatim notice strings + `data-notice` markers; new
  routes registered, withdrawn routes denied and unlinked.
- `tests/unit/test_p34_17_copy_batch.py` (6) — every new/changed batch
  row is well-formed and sha256-verified; every `data-copy` element on
  the wave's pages binds to batch rows; dynamic generated copy is
  distinguished from literal-bound elements; no orphan rows.
- `tests/unit/test_p34_11_copy_batch.py` — extended to the wave's
  static-text rows (DC-20, MB-01/02, ES-01…05, SG-01) so the older
  binding suite covers them too.
- `web/tests/unit/editorial.test.ts` — rewritten off the removed
  fixture: `assertReviewReleasable(null)`, recorded-review open-
  findings and fewer-than-two-reviewers cases.
- `web/tests/unit/corrections.test.ts`, `resolution-eval.test.ts` —
  expectations updated to the truthful wording.

## Boundaries

- **No production mutation.** `sig-ops publish-web --apply` was never
  run; HG-11 is untouched. The L2 republish is queued (DEFERRALS +
  RETURN PASS) with the verbatim rerun prompt above.
- No `ingestion_permitted` flip, no `HG-nn` tick, no spine
  `UPDATE`/`DELETE`; the withdrawn routes/records stay absent by
  construction, not by deletion.
- The operator's dispute e-mail address is in **no** committed file —
  it is injected via `SIG_DISPUTE_EMAIL` at the gated live build.
- New copy-batch rows are `pending`; the publish-side gate makes them
  unshippable until the operator confirms batch #1 verbatim (B-2).
- Handle re-keying is P34.18's; republish #2 (re-export) is P34.21b's —
  neither is claimed here.
